title: Comparative Statics of Information Acquisition and Risk Aversion
abstract: arXiv:2609.12149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how willingness to pay for information depends on risk aversion when a decision maker faces background risk and can acquire information before choosing from a menu of assets. We distinguish investment menus, whose payoffs are procyclical with background wealth, from insurance menus, whose payoffs are countercyclical. Our main results show that the interaction between asset cyclicality and the tail geometry of background risk determines the direction of the comparative statics. When the density of background risk is log-concave, willingness to pay for information decreases with risk aversion for investment menus, whereas with downward-log-convex background risk it increases with risk aversion for insurance menus. The proofs compare the distributions of terminal wealth with and without information and develop new aggregation arguments for state-dependent single-crossing comparisons. translated_title: 信息获取与风险厌恶的比较静态分析
translated_abstract: 当决策者面临背景风险并可以在从资产菜单中进行选择之前获取信息时，我们研究为信息付费的意愿如何依赖于风险厌恶程度。我们区分了两类菜单：投资菜单（其收益与背景财富呈顺周期关系）和保险菜单（其收益与背景财富呈逆周期关系）。我们的主要结果表明，资产的周期性与背景风险尾部几何形状之间的相互作用决定了比较静态分析的方向。当背景风险的密度为对数凹时，对于投资菜单而言，为信息付费的意愿随风险厌恶程度的增加而下降；而当背景风险为下对数凸时，对于保险菜单而言，为信息付费的意愿随风险厌恶程度的增加而上升。证明过程比较了在有信息和无信息两种情形下终端财富的分布，并为状态依赖的单交叉比较发展了新的聚合论证方法。我们还构建了在严格对数凹（下）条件下的逆转情形。
tldr: 本文揭示了信息支付意愿对风险厌恶的比较静态方向由资产收益的周期性（顺周期或逆周期）与背景风险的尾部几何形状共同决定：在背景风险密度对数凹时，投资菜单下的信息价值随风险厌恶增强而下降，而在下对数凸的背景风险下，保险菜单下的信息价值随风险厌恶增强而上升。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that the direction of comparative statics of willingness to pay for information with respect to risk aversion is jointly determined by asset cyclicality and the tail geometry of background risk: for log-concave background risk, willingness to pay decreases with risk aversion for investment menus, whereas for downward-log-convex background risk it increases with risk aversion for insurance menus.
